meta.title: Teach your agent to use a cloud desktop
meta.description: Your agent has a cloud computer — but may not know how to use it well. A short guide teaches it to open a real browser when login state matters, drive the GUI and shell when needed, hand control back to you for sign-in and captchas, and treat sleep as normal instead of fighting it. Adds no tools, touches no credentials, makes no network calls — harmless even if unused. Requires the official box plugin.
